def: to prostrate; by implication, to overthrow, decay

occurrences.text: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?
How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
